structural_rules.name: payload_integrity
structural_rules.description: Raw payload is valid UTF-8 JSON (or valid GZip-compressed JSON for CONAGUA SMN) and SHA-256 digest is recorded.

structural_rules.name: required_fields_present
structural_rules.description: All required identifiers and core meteorological fields (state_id, municipality_id, valid_date, tmax_c, tmin_c) are present.

structural_rules.name: municipality_fk_exists
structural_rules.description: Every (state_id, municipality_id) resolves to an active row in dim_municipality.

structural_rules.name: mexico_coordinate_bounds
structural_rules.description: Coordinates fall within valid Mexican territory bounds: 14.0 <= lat <= 33.0 and -119.0 <= lon <= -86.0.

structural_rules.name: timestamp_and_date_validity
structural_rules.description: issued_at is timezone-aware UTC TIMESTAMPTZ and valid_date / obs_date is a valid ISO-8601 DATE.

structural_rules.name: lead_day_domain
structural_rules.description: lead_day is a non-negative integer (0..7) consistent with valid_date - issued_at::date.

structural_rules.name: numeric_type_strictness
structural_rules.description: No NaN, Infinity, or unparseable string values in numeric measurements; nulls are explicit and never silently coerced to 0.

quality_rules.name: temperature_ordering
quality_rules.description: tmax_c >= tmin_c for every daily forecast and observation row.

quality_rules.name: physical_temperature_bounds
quality_rules.description: tmax_c and tmin_c fall within [-25.0, 55.0] degrees Celsius.

quality_rules.name: wind_nonnegative_and_gust_consistency
quality_rules.description: wind_speed_kmh >= 0 and wind_gust_kmh >= 0; flag warning if wind_gust_kmh < wind_speed_kmh.

quality_rules.name: idempotent_replay_zero_duplicates
quality_rules.description: Re-ingesting an identical batch produces zero duplicate rows and preserves existing primary keys.

quality_rules.name: zero_temporal_leakage
quality_rules.description: Forecast issued_at::date <= valid_date; ML feature matrix uses strictly past observations (obs_date < issued_at::date).

quality_rules.name: ml_cohort_completeness
quality_rules.description: At least 95% of the 32 Mexican state capital cohort has paired forecast and ERA5 ground-truth coverage for training.
